compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is a permission request dialog from an app named "Slice." The dialog is asking for permission to "View and manage your mail" using a Google account. The user's email address is displayed at the top of the dialog. The user is given two options at the bottom of the screen: "DENY" or "ALLOW" to either deny or grant the requested permission. The dialog also includes a note stating that by continuing, the user allows the app and Google to use their information in accordance with their respective terms of service and privacy policies.
